reply.emotion: joyful and carefree, feeling the rhythm and letting go
notes: Danser is a regular -er verb, so it follows the standard conjugation pattern for verbs like parler.
Do not confuse danser (to dance) with penser (to think).

senses.definition: To move your body to the rhythm of music.

examples.text: Ils aiment danser toute la nuit.
examples.translation: They like to dance all night long.
examples.emotion: excited and energetic, looking forward to a long night out

definitions: To move your body to the rhythm of music.
